lead: A proof over `Core\Request::headers()` cannot write `$headers[$name] ?? []` or `Core\Str::join($values, ", ")`.
body: The empty literal on the right of `??` is typed `array<mixed>`, so the declared `array<tainted string>` does not compile (`E0401`), and `Core\Str::join` takes `array<string>` only, so a list of tainted values does not compile there either. Guard the key with `Core\Arr::hasKey` and echo each value in an inner `foreach`, the way `docs/examples/core/Request/headers/02-a-header-on-two-lines.nvs` does.
